class.name: CbDrag
class.brief_description: Drag a slot onto another, with no code: moves, merges, splits, drops.
class.description: Put it under the [Control] of a row of a [CbList] of slots: that control is what is dragged, and what is dropped on (Godot's own drag and drop: a copy of the slot follows the cursor). - Dropped on another slot: what it holds moves there. The two trade, or, onto a stack of the same kind, as many as fit go onto it. - With Shift held when the drag starts: half of the stack (rounded up) goes there instead. - Let go outside [member inside] (the inventory screen): it is dropped, thrown out in front of the player. Each is an intent of the player's slots: it goes out in the player's own input, so every simulation carries it out and the player's own screen does not wait for the server.

members.member: The control a drag let go outside of drops the slot (the inventory screen). Found by the path, or by its name among the node's ancestors and their children (a row is a copy, deeper in a grid). Empty: a drag never drops.
